purpose: Segunda ronda de propuestas conceptuales del hero; sin cambios en la aplicación.

variants.title: D · Portada panorámica
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Render ONE polished desktop website HERO concept for IMSS JSDP Sonora, a staff-development institutional intranet. Landscape 1600x1000, edge-to-edge screen with crisp readable Spanish text, no device or browser frame. Header and hero only.
Shared visual identity: deep forest green #0b503e, white, restrained muted gold, elegant Patria-like serif heading, clean sans-serif supporting text. Header on white: original IMSS mark from reference 1 beside "JSDP Sonora"; nav "Inicio", "Conoce la JSDP", "Estructura", "Documentos"; "Iniciar sesión" button. Preserve the supplied official mark intact, unaltered and on white.
Hero verbatim: small identity "JSDP · Sonora"; headline "Jefatura de Servicios de Desarrollo de Personal"; body "Órgano de Operación Administrativa Desconcentrada Sonora del Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social."; single primary action "Conoce la JSDP" with right arrow.
Use only supplied photography, keeping the actual people/buildings, with natural colors. No invented institutional slogans, services, statistics, extra buttons, badges or decorative charts. No repeated giant logo. Strong typography, excellent spacing. No proposal label printed inside the website.
DIRECTION D: a panoramic architectural cover. Reference 2 is the actual office-building photograph. Let this single photo span nearly the entire hero width below the header. Overlay a large, solid-white, flat editorial text panel on the left, inset from edges, with the exact identity, headline, body and forest-green primary button. The panel occupies approximately the left half; the entrance, windows and palm trees remain clearly visible on the right. The photograph is the stage, not a separate right-column card. White space around typography creates a calm civic character. One muted gold rule accents the panel. No translucent text backgrounds, dark photo tint or miniatures. The full text panel and button must fit comfortably in the image. This should feel like arriving at the institution.

Give reference 2, the meeting photo, the largest cell; references 3, 4, 5 form smaller neighboring cells. Correct small captions must stay attached to their photos: meeting="Coordinación"; brown hospital="Unidades médicas"; white office="Unidades no médicas"; surgeons="Personas". Both gallery and text align as one well-balanced hero.

Place the intact mark at the far left with comfortable space, a thin muted-gold vertical divider beside it, then the existing "JSDP Sonora" name. Match the header's current height.
